title: chubu electric says hamaoka nuclear plant decommissioning documents were altered 2026 08 27
text:
TOKYO, Aug 27 (Reuters) - Chubu Electric Power (9502.T)
, opens new tab
 said on Thursday documents for fiscal 2024 decommissioning work at its Hamaoka nuclear power ​plant were improperly altered prior to submission to ‌Japan's nuclear decommissioning fund manager.
